integrity_statement: A finite standard-library verifier reconstructs all simplices, an acyclic discrete-Morse matching, and the complete seven-class rational character. The work does not claim independent scientific validation or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The new representation and quotient statements use rational coefficients only.
The nonequivariant wedge of four seven-spheres was published previously and is used as a reconstructed premise, not a new result.
No assertion is made about integral group lattices, torsion of subgroup quotients, or other Kneser graphs.
Targeted originality checks cannot exclude unindexed earlier equivariant results.
title: The Petersen two-matching homology realizes the standard five-letter module
